name: laser-level
description: A rotary laser level with two level rays and a complete three-leg stand.
useCase: Identify a rotary laser level for setting a horizontal reference plane.
misuse: Use level for a spirit level or laser for an optical emitter.

16.reason: Two full level rays leave the projector head above a complete three-leg stand.

24.reason: The larger projector and full opposing rays remain clear above all three stand legs.
